_about: Public-domain Bernhard Weiss (1827-1918, Berlin New Testament scholar) in English for the Word Hoard: 11 volumes from Internet Archive scans: the Biblical Theology of the New Testament (2 vols, 1882-1883), The Life of Christ (3 vols, 1883-1884), A Manual of Introduction to the New Testament (2 vols, 1887-1888), The Religion of the New Testament (1905) and the Commentary on the New Testament (vols 1, 2 and 4, 1906). Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 29 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

bweiss-biblical-theology-1: Biblical Theology of the New Testament, vol. I, tr. David Eaton (Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, 1882)
bweiss-biblical-theology-2: Biblical Theology of the New Testament, vol. II, tr. James E. Duguid (Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, 1883)
bweiss-life-of-christ-1: The Life of Christ, vol. I, tr. John Walter Hope (Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, 1883)
bweiss-life-of-christ-2: The Life of Christ, vol. II, tr. M. G. Hope (Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, 1883)
bweiss-life-of-christ-3: The Life of Christ, vol. III, tr. M. G. Hope (Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, 1884)
bweiss-manual-introduction-1: A Manual of Introduction to the New Testament, vol. I, tr. A. J. K. Davidson (London: Hodder and Stoughton; year garbled, probably MDCCCLXXXVII)
bweiss-manual-introduction-2: A Manual of Introduction to the New Testament, vol. II, tr. A. J. K. Davidson (London: Hodder and Stoughton, MDCCCLXXXVIII)
bweiss-religion-new-testament: The Religion of the New Testament, tr. George H. Schodde (New York: Funk & Wagnalls, 1905)

bweiss-commentary-2: A Commentary on the New Testament, vol. 2, tr. George H. Schodde and Epiphanius Wilson (New York: Funk & Wagnalls, 1906)
bweiss-commentary-4: A Commentary on the New Testament, vol. 4, tr. George H. Schodde and Epiphanius Wilson (New York: Funk & Wagnalls, 1906)
